description: This Java class 'TelemetrySubscriptionUpdate' manages telemetry subscription updates, including data handling, error reporting, and value extraction for telemetry data in the Thingsboard platform.

classes.name: TelemetrySubscriptionUpdate
classes.description: Represents an update for telemetry subscriptions, encapsulating data, error info, and methods to process telemetry data.

methods.name: TelemetrySubscriptionUpdate
methods.description: Constructors for initializing the update with data or error info.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns a map of telemetry data as TsValue objects, ignoring entries with invalid format.

methods.name: getLatestValues
methods.description: Returns a map of the latest timestamp for each data key.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the update object.
